title: Does this cover letter make the shortlist?
state:
Dear hiring team,

I'm applying for the Data Analyst role. For the past three years I've worked at a regional logistics company, where I built the weekly delivery dashboard in Power BI that operations still uses every morning. I taught myself SQL during that time and now write most of our reporting queries. Before that I worked in retail for four years, which I mention because it taught me how the numbers on a screen turn into real decisions on a shop floor. I don't have a degree in statistics, but I finished the Google Data Analytics certificate last spring. I'd be glad to walk you through the dashboard and the problems it solved.

Best,
Daniel

question.instructions: Should this applicant be shortlisted for an interview for a Data Analyst role?
